goal:
Assign work to relevant agents
1. Navigate to the Service Desk > Incidents. 

2. You have to assign the following incidents to relevant agents: WAM3338146, WAM3338992, WAM3338688, WAM3338858, WAM3338458. You can filter the list using each incident number and use the 'Assigned to' field to assign an incident.

3. You have to ensure that each incident is assigned to a relevant agent based on the category of the incident.

The category wise agents are as follows. You can assign an incident to ANY agent from the category:
Database agents: Michael-Travis Edwards-Mcbride, Jimmy-Kristin Schroeder-Smith 
Network agents: Johnny-Jennifer Schmidt-Donaldson, Phyllis-Wendy Miller-Phillips 
Software agents: Matthew-Kevin Jones-Weaver, Samuel-Kristen Pierce-Ortiz
